rationale: The agent upgraded the Caddy dependency and ran go mod tidy, but did not update the Storage method signatures to match the upgraded certmagic interfaces. The final verifier fails at build time with concrete Go compiler diagnostics showing Delete, Unlock, and other methods still have the old non-context API while the upgraded tests/interfaces expect context.Context parameters. This is a source API/type inconsistency rather than an installation or semantic runtime failure.

evidence.quote: ./storage.go:33:24: cannot use (*Storage)(nil) (value of type *Storage) as type certmagic.Storage in variable declaration:

have Delete(key string) error
E         		want Delete(ctx context.Context, key string) error
./storage_test.go:50:32: too many arguments in call to s.Exists
